title: FamilyDenominatorModel
description: Machine-readable denominator model for a single Aspose family. Defines the source-of-truth counts for coverage computation.

api_catalog_sha256.description: SHA256 hex of the api-catalog.json used for this denominator. Null if no reflection catalog exists.

api_catalog_source.description: Relative path to the api-catalog.json that was hashed

total_lowcode_types.description: Total public types discovered in the plugin namespace

workflow_root_types.description: Count of WORKFLOW_ROOT types (directly executable IPlugin implementations). Null if not yet classified.

non_runnable_types.description: Count of non-runnable types (OPTIONS, RESULT, callbacks, etc.). Null if not yet classified.

allowed_pilot_types.description: List of type short-names allowed in the current pilot scope. Null means unrestricted (all runnable types allowed).

allowed_pilot_count.description: Count of allowed_pilot_types. Null if unrestricted.

denominator_basis.description: Which denominator is primary for coverage computation. FULL_SOT=all types, WORKFLOW_ROOT=only IPlugin types, PILOT_ALLOWED=only allowed_types list.

denominator_basis_note.description: Human-readable explanation of why this basis was chosen

runnable_scenarios.description: The effective denominator for coverage. Equal to allowed_pilot_count if basis=PILOT_ALLOWED, workflow_root_types if basis=WORKFLOW_ROOT, or a computed value for FULL_SOT.

runnable_scenarios_basis.description: Clarifies which basis the runnable_scenarios count uses. May be an enum value or a descriptive string.

runnable_scenario_ids.description: Stable scenario IDs for the runnable set. Required if runnable_scenarios <= 30.

published_count.description: Scenarios with merged PRs (post-merge verified in target repo)

pr_ready_count.description: Scenarios with open live PRs awaiting merge

pr_dry_run_ready_count.description: Scenarios with validated dry-run package awaiting APPROVE_LIVE_PR

reviewer_passed_awaiting_pr_count.description: Scenarios where reviewer passed but no PR package yet

blocked_count.description: Scenarios blocked by technical issues (e.g., LLM hallucination, missing fixture)

excluded_count.description: Scenarios excluded from current scope (by allowed_types or type classification)

coverage_pct_of_total_types.description: Coverage percentage against all types in namespace

evidence_sources.description: List of evidence file paths used to compute this denominator

last_verified_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last verification against source
